summary: Iteration 118 — Consumer UX / Listen Hub (Classic B web). All backend + web tests PASS. 5/5 backend pytest cases pass for POST /api/radio/feedback (like adds favorite artist, less moves to disliked, persistence verified via /api/auth/me, bad action returns 400 {code:bad_action}, unauth returns 401). Playwright verified: Home B chips (All/ForYou/Local/Trending only — no legacy chips), chip re-scoping of the For-You rail heading (For You / Local stations / Trending now) and non-empty grid (6 flagships), Earn/Play/Shop/Social rails navigate to /wallet /play /shop /community, /listen route renders listen-hub with all quicklinks + old-hub-link (href=/radio) + flagships + Start My Radio btn. Start My Radio navigates to /radio?ch=my&autoplay=1 and auto-starts an ON AIR session; radio-like-btn and radio-less-btn are enabled during playback, POST /api/radio/feedback fires, and success toasts render ('Nice — we'll play more like this' / 'Got it — you'll hear this less').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py radio_feedback response returns favorite_artists/disliked_artists as INTs (counts) — the review-request spec description said it returns the ARRAYS. Frontend does not consume the arrays so this is fine, but if any future consumer expects arrays the contract should be aligned. Non-blocking.

The four 401 console errors are unrelated polling endpoints (not feature under test).
